title: Projection: Closest Is Perpendicular
topic: Project a vector u onto the line spanned by v. The foot of the perpendicular is proj_v(u) — the closest point on the line. The leftover u minus its projection is orthogonal to v. Algebraically, proj_v(u) = (u·v / v·v) v.

beats.narration: Project a vector onto a line — what is the closest point?

elements.content: Drop a perpendicular. That's the answer.

beats.narration: Here is a vector u, and a line through the origin spanning some direction v. We want the shadow u casts on the line.

beats.narration: Drop a perpendicular from u down to the line. Where it lands is the projection — the closest point. Everything left over is orthogonal to v.
